WITH m AS (
 SELECT zoneref, facetregistry,
  (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * POWER((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
  (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
  (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
 FROM mesh
), s AS (
 SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel,
  COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS total_meshes,
  COUNT(m.facetregistry) FILTER (WHERE m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.res < 1.0 AND m.geom < 0.5) AS hf_meshes,
  AVG(m.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(m.res) AS avg_res, AVG(m.geom) AS avg_geom
 FROM sites si LEFT JOIN m ON m.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
 GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes,
 ROUND(hf_meshes * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_meshes, 0), 2) AS hf_percentage,
 ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_mesh_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geom, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
 CASE WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality' ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM s
ORDER BY hf_percentage DESC NULLS LAST, site_code

WITH r AS (
 SELECT r.logregistry AS registration_id, r.arcref AS project_id,
  (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS registration_accuracy_mm,
  (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS error_value_mm,
  r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric / ((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric * SQRT(1 + (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric / (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric)) AS rar
 FROM registration r JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = r.arcref AND pc.crewref = r.crewref)
SELECT registration_id, project_id, registration_accuracy_mm, error_value_mm, ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
 CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence' WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence' ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level
FROM r ORDER BY rar DESC

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name,
 ROUND(AVG(100 - 2.5*ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20) - POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50)/2), 1.5) - 600/((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100)), 2) AS avg_esi
FROM sites si JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, c.structstate AS structural_state,
 si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status,
 CASE WHEN (si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%') AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
  THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites si JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
note: Ambiguous whether to list only risk-zone sites; returns all site/conservation rows with the category.

WITH scan_m AS (
 SELECT s.zoneref,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pdens,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise,
  (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
  (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err
 FROM scans s
 JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
 JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref
), scan_k AS (
 SELECT zoneref, noise, err, res,
  cov * (1 + lap/100 * (1 - cov/100)) AS sce,
  res / (acc * SQRT(1 + err/acc)) AS rar,
  LOG(10, res*1000) / LOG(10, pdens) * 5 AS sri
 FROM scan_m
), scan_q AS (
 SELECT zoneref, noise, err, res, sce, rar,
  POWER(10/sri, 1.5) * (sce/100) * POWER(1 - noise/30, 2) AS sqs
 FROM scan_k
), mesh_k AS (
 SELECT zoneref,
  (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * POWER((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
  (mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric / (SQRT((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric) * (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric) * 0.01 AS tdi,
  (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
 FROM mesh
), mesh_s AS (
 SELECT zoneref, AVG(mcr * (tdi/10) * (1 + EXP(-geom))) AS mfs FROM mesh_k GROUP BY zoneref
), site_s AS (
 SELECT zoneref, AVG(sqs) AS sqs, AVG(sce) AS sce, AVG(rar) AS rar, AVG(noise) AS noise, AVG(err) AS err, AVG(res) AS res
 FROM scan_q GROUP BY zoneref
), dpq AS (
 SELECT ss.zoneref, m.mfs, ss.rar, ss.sce, ss.err, ss.res,
  (ss.sqs*0.4 + m.mfs*0.4 + ss.sce*0.2 - 5*SQRT(ss.noise/10)) AS adc
 FROM site_s ss JOIN mesh_s m ON m.zoneref = ss.zoneref
)
SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name,
 ROUND(0.3*d.adc + 0.3*d.mfs + 0.2*d.rar + 0.2*d.sce - 2*SQRT(d.err/d.res), 2) AS dpq
FROM dpq d JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = d.zoneref
ORDER BY dpq DESC

WITH base AS (
 SELECT si.zoneregistry,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric / NULLIF((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric, 0) AS pcdr,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cd,
  (f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric AS feats
 FROM sites si
 LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
 LEFT JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
 LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref
 LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code,
 ROUND(AVG(pcdr), 2) AS avg_pcdr,
 ROUND(AVG(feats / NULLIF(pcdr * SQRT(cd), 0) * 1000), 2) AS avg_fee
FROM base
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST, site_code

WITH p AS (
 SELECT p.flowregistry,
  CASE
   WHEN p.flowsoft ~* '^(agi|metashape)' THEN 'Agisoft'
   WHEN p.flowsoft ~* '^(cloud ?compare|c\.?c\.?)$' THEN 'CloudCompare'
   WHEN p.flowsoft ~* '^geo' THEN 'Geomagic'
   WHEN p.flowsoft ~* '^(reality ?capture|r\.?c\.?)$' THEN 'RealityCapture'
   ELSE p.flowsoft END AS software,
  p.flowstage AS stage,
  (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
  (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
  (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
  REPLACE(s.size, ' GB', '')::numeric AS gb,
  (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS pts
 FROM processing p
 JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
 JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
), g AS (
 SELECT software, stage, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu, AVG(gb) AS avg_gb,
  AVG(gb * LOG(10, pts) / (hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200)) AS avg_per,
  COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count
 FROM p GROUP BY software, stage
)
SELECT software, stage, ROUND(avg_hrs, 1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(avg_cpu, 1) AS avg_cpu_usage, ROUND(avg_gpu, 1) AS avg_gpu_usage,
 ROUND(avg_gb, 1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(avg_per, 1) AS avg_per,
 CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
 workflow_count
FROM g
ORDER BY efficiency_status, avg_per
note: File size and total points come from scans/pointcloud linked to processing via site (zoneref); software spellings normalised.

WITH e AS (
 SELECT zoneref,
  (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric AS temp,
  (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric AS hum,
  (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric AS lux
 FROM environment
), s AS (
 SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel, AVG(temp) AS avg_temp, AVG(hum) AS avg_hum, AVG(lux) AS avg_lux,
  AVG(100 - 2.5*ABS(temp - 20) - POWER(ABS((hum - 50)/2), 1.5) - 600/(lux + 100)) AS avg_esi
 FROM sites si JOIN e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
 GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
 ROUND(avg_temp, 1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_hum, 1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(avg_lux, 1) AS avg_illumination,
 ROUND(avg_esi, 1) AS avg_esi,
 NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile,
 CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions' WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions' WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions' ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM s
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name,
 ROUND(AVG(
  POWER(10.0 / (LOG(10, ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric)*1000) / LOG(10, (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric) * 5), 1.5)
  * ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric * (1 + (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric/100 * (1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric/100)) / 100)
  * POWER(1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric/30, 2)
 ), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH w AS (
 SELECT e.equipregistry,
  (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
  (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
  (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
  REPLACE(s.size, ' GB', '')::numeric AS gb,
  (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts
 FROM equipment e
 LEFT JOIN processing p ON p.equipref = e.equipregistry
 LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
 LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = p.zoneref AND m.equipref = p.equipref
), agg AS (
 SELECT equipregistry,
  AVG(hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 2 / NULLIF(gb * 10 * LOG(10, verts + 10000), 0)) AS pru,
  AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu
 FROM w GROUP BY equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id,
 ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru,
 ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
 RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) AS efficiency_rank,
 CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
 json_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM agg
ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST, equipment_id
note: File size via scans on site, vertices via mesh on site+equipment; equipment without processing data has NULL PRU.
